architecture: SolidCraft native_document is canonical for definitions, geometry, occurrences, origins, joints, links, contact, study keys and configuration tables. Host domain data contains review settings, named coordinate poses, constraint-set membership, lock restoration, procurement exclusions, tolerance inputs and report provenance. Domain workers return complete proposals for the Jobs owner to apply once through Store.

backend.command: PYTHONPATH=src O3D_ENGINE_BINARY=<source-built oxygen bridge> .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_assemblies.py

browser.result: Real integrated shell, disposable native slider project. Swept stop between clear endpoints, named home persistence after browser reload, native metadata edit, BOM reconciliation and CSV download, light/dark themes, no page errors.
browser.scope: Desktop Chromium on Linux; no cross-platform or physical-fit inference.

rows.workflow: Nested definition tree with stable occurrence paths; native component creation/activation and authored geometry; shared-instance dimension propagation and independent copied definition graph.
Instance versus independent copy, parent/world rigid placements, pending capture/revert and Store undo/redo.
Content-addressed .solidcraft source insertion and controlled source revision through relink preserve occurrences and transforms; embedded exact bodies reopen without reading source geometry.
remaining: Native designs with unresolved external link dependencies are rejected; automatic project-closure packaging remains interop work.
Linked interfaces that disappear are surfaced by native joint diagnostics, but a source-update interface-loss fixture is pending.

rows.workflow: Persisted parent-relative grounding, captured/pending position transactions, explicit anchor diagnostics and a warning for native implicit-anchor fallback.
remaining: Separate world-pin authoring shortcut is not present; a joint against root provides a world reference.
The native solver retains its first-joint-A fallback when no explicit anchor participates; the UI discloses this rather than claiming an explicit engineering anchor.

rows.workflow: Native persistent face/circle/edge/point origins and attachment inspection with feature provenance; explicit stale/ambiguous occurrence guard.
remaining: Executed acceptance covers planar-face parameter changes and suppressed/lost faces; hole-circle/edge, reordered topology and all ambiguous topology cases still require fixtures.

rows.workflow: Seven native joint families with independently checked DOFs and permitted rigid transforms after persisted drive and reopen.
Native parallel/perpendicular/angle/point-plane/point-line/line-plane relations and atomically created, suppressible host constraint sets.
remaining: Fusion Center and all-faces Tangent constraints have no established native equivalent; no substitute geometry is inferred.
Offset-limit/rest behavior for every geometric relation is not established by this fixture.

rows.workflow: Persisted drive, multi-coordinate limits, suppression, lock/unlock with original-limit restoration, named home/rest poses, floating/conflict/reference diagnostics and revision rejection.
remaining: Rest poses are stored kinematic coordinates, not a spring/force model.
Every closed-loop lock/home combination and inconsistent transmission cycle still needs acceptance.

rows.workflow: Native as-built joints and rigid groups preserve nonidentity placements; hinge drive retains group relative geometry; suppression releases intended DOFs.
Motion-link, gear, rack-pinion, screw and cam command editors use native coupled mechanisms. Gear/rack/screw numerical ratios are independently checked.
remaining: Cam profile variants, parameter-driven recoupling and inconsistent cycles are exposed native workflows with independent acceptance still pending.

rows.workflow: Persisted selected/all contact sets and swept collision during drive; movement away and disabled contact work; an over-budget drive fails without committing the proposed state.
remaining: Executed integration includes translating and rotating blockers with clear endpoints; thin tilted plates and curved moving-body fixtures remain to be added.
No contact forces, compliance or friction are modeled.

rows.workflow: All native-body pairs, exact clearance/intersection, containment, tangency, positive gap and explicit unresolved budget results; report ignores exploded/pending display offsets.
Native keyed studies/playback, retained pose exports, duration-scaled kinematics, sampled interference, associative trace creation/editing and provenance-aware saved reports.
remaining: Executed integration uses a linear slider and exact kinematic numbers; closed-loop four-bar and lead-screw trajectories still need independent acceptance.
Sampled motion interference is explicitly labeled sampled; between-sample safety comes from enabled swept contact, not an empty sampled collision list.

rows.workflow: Persisted automatic/manual exploded-view definitions; display transforms do not modify canonical engineering placements; reset restores assembled display.
remaining: Storyboard timing and rendered animation publication belong to visualization; these views are assembly presentation poses only.

rows.workflow: Native flat/top BOM, repeated quantities, part-number/definition grouping, kit controls, metadata and CSV; stable row keys/feature IDs/full occurrence paths for drawing associations; explicit per-configuration procurement exclusions.
remaining: Grouped-kit children retain upstream display items and do not yet carry stable drawing association keys; default flat ungrouped BOM provides stable associations.
A configured exclusion inside a grouped kit is explicitly refused; use ungrouped BOM until native child identities are exposed.
Geometry suppression alone retains a procurement item; exclusion must be explicit.

rows.workflow: Saved explicit signed worst-case dimensional intervals support hole/shaft clearance and axial fastener engagement/grip arithmetic with acceptance limits; missing limits remain unresolved.
remaining: No ISO fit-class lookup or standards table, thread strength, preload, bottoming surface model or manufacturing process assumption is inferred.
Measured physical fit and supplier review remain separate validation.

limitations: Rows describe executed workflows and explicit gaps, not a claimed percentage of Fusion parity.
Source-link imports with unresolved external dependencies are rejected. Filesystem paths are not accepted as untrusted assembly command parameters.
Long operations are child-process jobs; engine failures and budget exhaustion remain errors/unresolved rather than passed motion or fit.
